disclaimer: Simulated cohort: projections from a virtual workforce on real 2025 weather under stated behavioural and physiological assumptions (docs/SIMULATION.md). They are not measured health outcomes, do not show that Zill reduces real heat illness (only a prospective pilot can, docs/PILOT.md), and the ground-truth model is itself a simplification.
